def blob(name,at,scale,mat,seed):
    rng=random.Random(seed);vs=[];fs=[];n=10;rings=6
    for j in range(rings+1):
        phi=math.pi*j/rings
        for i in range(n):
            theta=math.tau*i/n;rad=1+.09*math.sin(theta*3+j*.9)+rng.uniform(-.04,.04)
            vs.append((at[0]+math.sin(phi)*math.cos(theta)*scale[0]*rad,at[1]+math.sin(phi)*math.sin(theta)*scale[1]*rad,at[2]+math.cos(phi)*scale[2]*rad))
    for j in range(rings):
        for i in range(n):
            a=j*n+i;b=j*n+(i+1)%n;fs.append((a,b,b+n,a+n))
    o=mesh(name,vs,fs,mat,.6)
    for p in o.data.polygons:p.use_smooth=True
    return o
def palm(x,z,h=4.2,lean=.7,ang=0):

    points=[(x+lean*(t*t)*math.cos(ang),y+lean*(t*t)*math.sin(ang),g+h*t) for t in [i/7 for i in range(8)]]

            vs.extend([c-side-Vector((0,0,.095)),c+Vector((0,0,.06)),c+side-Vector((0,0,.095))])
